system: VerbNet Action×Role typed fiber search + UD dependency-hint frontend (Stanza en_ewt, package "ewt")
compare_to: wimcor-typed-fiber-summary.json (legacy positional-heuristic frontend, same protocol, run in the same evaluation session)
interpretation: Replacing chooseActionRoles's positional-offset subject/object heuristic (OpenDomain.hs) with a UD dependency parse (scripts/annotate_dependency_hints.py) more than doubles metonymic F1 (0.0518 -> 0.1158) and raises coverage from 39% to 60%, with metonymic precision also improving (0.386 -> 0.429) rather than trading precision for recall. Both frontends route through the identical compiled Agda runtimeCheck, so this is a recall/coverage gain at an unchanged formal safety boundary, not a relaxation of it. Absolute numbers remain modest by open-domain-classifier standards: exact endpoint recall stays tiny (5/10487) because entity linking (a separate, still-unaddressed bottleneck -- see data/entity-link-snapshot.tsv) is unchanged, and the no-verbnet ablation is byte-identical to full for both frontends, indicating VerbNet-imported Action×Role rows are not yet contributing any successful rewrite on this corpus regardless of frontend.
